stories.title: Ramayana: Part 1
stories.about: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the epic poem Ramayana by Valmiki, which chronicles the life and trials of Prince Rama. It is the first of a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Sunny Deol, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.
stories.headline: Ramayana: Part 1 premiered at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on 27 October 2026, and was released worldwide on 5 November, coinciding with the Diwali holidays.

stories.title: Guy Fawkes Night
stories.about: Guy Fawkes Night, also known as Guy Fawkes Day, Bonfire Night and Fireworks Night, is an annual commemoration observed on 5 November, primarily in Great Britain, involving bonfires and fireworks displays. Its history begins with the events of 5 November 1605 O.S., when Guy Fawkes, a member of the Gunpowder Plot, was arrested while guarding explosives the plotters had placed beneath the House of Lords. The Catholic plotters had intended to assassinate Protestant King James I and his parliament. Celebrating that the king had survived, people lit bonfires around London. Months later, the Observance of 5th November Act 1605 mandated an annual public day of thanksgiving for the plot's failure.
stories.headline: Guy Fawkes Night, also known as Guy Fawkes Day, Bonfire Night and Fireworks Night, is an annual commemoration observed on 5 November, primarily in Great Britain, involving bonfires and fireworks displays.

stories.title: 2026 United States elections
stories.about: Elections in the United States were held on November 3, 2026. In these midterm elections, which occurred during the non-consecutive second term of incumbent Republican president Donald Trump, all 435 seats in the U.S. House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 seats in the U.S. Senate were contested to determine the 120th United States Congress. Thirty-nine state and territorial U.S. gubernatorial elections, attorney general elections, and numerous state and local elections were also contested. In one of the worst instances of the six-year itch suffered by a president serving a second term, the opposition Democratic Party won in a landslide victory, gaining a majority of seats in both houses of Congress and state governments across the United States, undoing the legacy of the Tea Party wave of 2010 and giving the Democrats their largest congressional majority since the 102nd United States Congress.

stories.title: 2028 United States Senate elections
stories.summary: Senate election for the 121st US Congress
stories.about: The 2028 United States Senate elections will be held on November 7, 2028, with 34 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested in regular elections, the winners of which will serve 6-year terms in the United States Congress from January 3, 2029, to January 3, 2035, which will include the entire term of the president who wins the 2028 presidential election and the first two years of the 2032 presidential election winner's term. Senators are divided into three classes whose terms are staggered so that a different class is elected every other year. Class 3 senators were last elected in 2022, and will be up for election again in 2028. A special election is expected to be held in Tennessee, to fill Marsha Blackburn's unexpired Senate term. These elections will run concurrently with the 2028 United States presidential election. Democrats are defending five seats in states that voted for Donald Trump in 2024.
stories.headline: A special election is expected to be held in Tennessee, to fill Marsha Blackburn's unexpired Senate term.

stories.title: Red states and blue states
stories.about: Starting with the 2000 United States presidential election, the term red state has been used to refer to states which predominantly vote for the Republican Party, and the term blue state has been used to refer to states which predominantly vote for the Democratic Party. By contrast, states where the predominant vote fluctuates between Democratic and Republican nominees are known as swing states or purple states. Examining patterns within states reveals that the reversal of the two parties' geographic bases has happened at the state level, but it is more complicated locally, with urban–rural divides associated with many of the largest changes.

stories.title: .xyz
stories.about: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program. Its name consists of the last three letters of the Latin-script alphabet. XYZ.com and CentralNic are the registries for the domain, which was created by entrepreneur Daniel Negari. It became available to the general public on June 2, 2014, thereafter becoming widely used by tech startups, creators, and Web3 projects.
stories.headline: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program.

stories.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
stories.about: Godzilla Minus Zero  is a 2026 Japanese epic kaiju film written, directed, and with visual effects by Takashi Yamazaki. A sequel to Godzilla Minus One (2023), it is the 39th film in the Godzilla franchise, the 34th film thereof produced by Toho, and the sixth installment in the franchise's Reiwa era. The film stars Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Hidetaka Yoshioka, Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, Sakura Ando, and Miou Tanaka reprising their roles from Minus One, with Min Tanaka, Masami Nagasawa, and Jun Kunimura also starring as new characters. In the film, set in 1949, postwar Japan struggles to rebuild when it faces a new threat from King Ghidorah; Godzilla regenerates and resurfaces to combat the monster.
